finding: A unit with attached armaments requires an equipment reference chosen at confirmation; the optional action must be distinguished from that mandatory reference. Existing code stores the equipment as an optional-cost selection and omits it from TargetObjectIds. Needs a focused authority and executable reconstruction.

source: Current official SFD·045/221 and UNL-106/219 plus CoreRuleEngine.IsStackSpellItem
finding: The official text permits ability targets, while the shared StackSpell classifier only accepts registered spell behaviors. Captured trigger effects require executable reproduction and a shared type/target policy.
Modes have Chinese labels and independent command identities. Multiple copies still need an unambiguous user-visible origin label beyond backend instance identity.
